name: doodl
description: Open source multiplayer drawing and guessing game. No ads, self-hostable.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @doodl/shared && npm run build -w @doodl/server && npm run build -w @doodl/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @doodl/shared && npm run build -w @doodl/server && npm run test -w @doodl/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @doodl/server && npm run typecheck -w @doodl/client
